title: feat(studio): the flow designer opens full-screen on its metadata address; no flow rail (#36903)
body:
Fixes #36903
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no page under `skills/` or `content/docs/` names the Automations rail's strings or teaches overriding a Studio console string

## 维护者速读

- 搭建者在 Studio 点开一个流程，会在右侧全屏打开它的设计器，左上角 × 回到流程列表，‹ › 按列表顺序看上一个、下一个；原来设计器左侧那一列流程列表没有了，组织级流程也在同样的新地址上打开。流程的“审阅草稿”链接打开通用详情页并显示审阅；权限集的审阅链接照旧打开它的权限矩阵页。
- 这是 Studio 重构专题（左侧菜单 → 列表 → 右侧全屏详情）里流程设计器的一张，和对象、权限集的设计器共用同一套“设计器页面”写法。
- 出错时最可能是旧书签没跳对、或某个流程打不开；不改数据和元数据协议。原流程列表专用的 9 条界面文字随 19.0.0 大版本退役，已在变更说明里逐条列出（若有人自定义过这几条翻译，自定义将不再显示），回退这个 PR 即可恢复。
- 这个 PR 超过 3000 行，按您的裁决在席位审核后请您审核；另有一个问题请您定：流程列表要不要加“触发对象”和“运行状态”两列（需要另开一张协议卡）。

## What changes

- **The flow designer is full-screen on its metadata address.** `/studio/PACKAGE/metadata/flow/NAME` mounts the designer (`AutomationsPillar`, now fixed on one flow named by the route). The area decides it through the shared designer-page helper in `metadataArea.ts` (`AREA_DESIGNER_PAGE_TYPES`, `areaItemOpensDesignerPage`, `areaDesignerItemOf`), now on main from #37089; after the merges the list is `['permission', 'object', 'flow']`. Header: the shared full-screen item header (`ResourceDetailHeader`): × back to the list with its filters, ‹ › in the list's order (decision 10), title, type, package, and the flow's ⋯ (New similar, Delete). Tabs: Canvas, Variables, Runs, Problems, Debug, then References, History, Source from `item-tools/ItemToolTabs` (hand-off §2); the open tab is `?tab=` (`flowDesignerTabs.ts`).
- **No flow rail.** The rail, its search, object groups, legend, status dots, contributed-flow rows and the pillar's own New dialog are deleted. Create is the list's 「新建」 (`MetadataListCreateDialog`, same presets).
- **Nine released console strings are retired, declared (M1, ruling 7153171432 「B」 with 7153326968 「下一版是大版本 19.0.0」).** The nine `engine.studio.auto.*` keys only the rail read (`heading`, `none`, `emptyMain`, `group.noObject`, `kind.record`, `kind.scheduled`, `kind.screen`, `kind.autolaunched`, `legend`) are removed from `en` and `zh` of `@object-ui/i18n`'s studio namespace. The changeset declares `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, carries the BREAKING note, the ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` disposition and a 「Removed translation keys」 list, and keeps `'@object-ui/i18n': patch` (the one `major` is #37223's). `engine.studio.org.none` is kept: S5 reads it.
- **Address switch.** `flow` leaves `STUDIO_ITEM_PILLAR` (with #37168's `object` gone too, it is empty), so `studioItemPath`, ⌘K, the AI artifact links and the Changes drawer open the new address. Old addresses redirect (`automationsPillarRedirect.ts`): `/automations?surface=flow:NAME` to the flow, bare `/automations` to the list; `?view=`/`?nav=` dropped, everything else kept (including `?changes=review`).
- **`~org` flows** live on the package-less scope's own area leg: list `/studio/~org/metadata/flow?source=runtime`, flow `/studio/~org/metadata/flow/NAME?source=runtime`. Its list offers no 「新建」, and when it is empty it says how a packaged flow is changed instead (`engine.studio.org.none`, ADR-0146 D11), through a new optional `emptyListHint` on the area host. An empty, unsearched list there reads as empty, not as "No matches for """.
- **Copilot context** has the sisters' shape: a designer on its metadata address sends `{ pillar: STUDIO_METADATA_AREA, artifact }`, the same block as #37089 (on main) and #37168, plus `orgScopeFlowOf` for the `~org` leg.
- **Review links, in plain words:** a flow's review link opens the general item page with its review; a permission set's review link keeps its matrix page; an object's opens the general item page with its review, as #37168 shipped it.
- **One predicate for the generic page.** `?review=1` and `?scope=environment` keep an item on the generic item page through `areaItemAsksGenericPage`, with #37168's text, for a designer type whose generic page serves that review (the flow). A type whose item page is its own editor (`registerMetadataResource`'s `EditPage`: the permission set's matrix) has no generic review, so it keeps its designer page, exactly as main does. Seat 4 recorded this as the measured form of its ruling A (7157282796). See Acceptance notes.
- **Taken name in this package.** The list dialog's flow create says 「This package already has an automation…」 (`engine.studio.auto.createTaken`) and offers Open, to the flow's address, when the flow holding the identifier is this package's; `createTakenElsewhere` otherwise.
- **Kept (card item 6):** the copilot's refresh after its edits (`useMetadataRefreshNonce`) and its current-item report (`onSurfaceLabelChange`). #36726's pinned publish on Save and on the switch is unchanged; the list dialog's flow create publishes with `publishCreated`.
- **Run status (card item 2):** the list has no column for it or for the trigger object (the spec's flow columns are NAME, LABEL, type, DESCRIPTION). Both stay on the designer header's Trigger and Status pills. No `packages/spec` change; the column question is a fork for the maintainer.

## Empty state and old deep links (card item 7)

- A package with no flow: the flow list's own empty state. The designer is never opened on nothing.
- An address naming a flow the package does not hold: one block, 「The link names flow “NAME”, which is not here.」, nothing else opened. A package-less flow opens in `~org` instead (objectui#11553).
- Old `/studio/PACKAGE/automations`, `/studio/BASE.custom/automations` and `/studio/~org/automations` links redirect as above. `…/metadata/flow/NAME/history` opens the History tab.
- Delete returns to the flow list (its filters kept); no other flow is opened in the deleted one's place.

## Tests

- This round:
  - `heldFlowLeave-26705`: an unsaved, NOT held edit. × asks, Cancel keeps the edit, OK lands on the list with nothing sent; › the same, onto the next flow; CONTROL: after Save neither asks. The Changes sheet's flow request: over a dirty or a held edit it asks, then lands; on the open flow it does nothing; CONTROL: no edit, no question.
  - `packageLessFlows-11553`, through the real surface: the old address of a package flow lands on its address with the designer open; a read-only base's old address naming a pair-added flow lands on the base's address, writable, with the pair chip; the pair's old address lands on the pair's own address; CONTROL: the base's own flow stays read-only. Also the `~org` Changes request landing on the scope's flow, and the empty `~org` list's guidance.
  - `tabs-12454`: `?tab=runs` and `?tab=history` open their panel on the real designer; CONTROL: no tab, Canvas.
  - `createTaken-26917`: a published flow in this package reads `createTaken` and Open lands on `/studio/PKG/metadata/flow/escalate`; another package's keeps `Elsewhere` and no Open.
  - `aiChipLabel`: repinned to `{ pillar: 'metadata', artifact }`.
  - `customizeFlow-28570`: the Restore dialog's label is read off the header's title.
- Earlier rounds: the remaining `AutomationsPillar.*` suites and the `StudioDesignSurface.*` / `StudioMetadataArea.*` suites that open a flow, converted to the address. Deleted as rail-only, each with the pin that covers what is left: `AutomationsPillar.railSearch-11794`, `FlowStatusDot`, `FlowStatusDot.registration-12349`, `StudioDesignSurface.railUnboundReason-11281` (the unbound reason is on the header's Status pill, `flowStatusTruth-11779`), `.automationsRailOrder-12612`, `.draftObjectFlowGroup-29706`, and the rail cases in `.emptyStates-12514`, `.homeLoop-12513`, `.oneSurface-28572`, `.autosaveSwitch-11232`, `.heldFlowCreate-26845`, `StudioRail.noMatches-26733`. New pins: `automationsPillarRedirect.test.ts`, `flowDesignerTabs.test.ts`, the helper and predicate cases in `metadataArea.test.ts`, the designer and `/history` routes in `StudioMetadataArea.routes-28561`.

## Acceptance notes

- **M1, how it ended.** Round 2 first restored the ten released keys (the L1's preferred fix). The maintainer then ruled retire-and-declare (7153171432 「B」; next release is the major, 7153326968), so this round removes the nine keys no code reads and declares them; the tenth, `engine.studio.org.none`, is read again by the `~org` list (S5) and stays. `studioAutomationCopy.plainLanguage-11659`'s heading case went with its row (N1, first option). The ~35 keys main had already removed are #37223's, not declared here.
- **Merged `origin/main` at `bc3ec37a`, which holds #37089 (the permission designer).** The merge unions the two designers: `AREA_DESIGNER_PAGE_TYPES = ['permission', 'flow']`, `STUDIO_ITEM_PILLAR` keeps `object` only, and `AreaItemOpen` mounts `AutomationsPillar` for a flow and `StudioPermissionSetPage` for a set. Two consequences, both deliberate:
  - **Declared deviation, accepted (seat 4, 7157282796): a permission set's `?review=1` keeps main's behaviour and opens the matrix page.** The ruling said uniform (A), on this branch's recommendation. Checking it showed the premise was false. For a type whose item page is its own editor, the generic page never draws: `MetadataResourceEditPage` hands the item to the registered `PermissionMatrixEditPage`, which has no draft review. Neither it nor main's `StudioPermissionSetPage` reads `?review=1`. Uniform would therefore have sent a set's review link to Setup's matrix editor, with no review sheet and outside the Studio page: a regression. So `AreaItemOpen` asks the generic page only for a type with no own `EditPage`. That is the flow here and the object in #37168 (#37168 should check the object's registry before relying on it). Pinned in `routes-28561` (`?review=1` keeps the matrix page), and ablated: dropping the `EditPage` guard reds it, `1 failed | 31 passed (32)`, restored to the HEAD blob. The flow's `?review=1` still opens the generic page and its review (the case beside it).
  - **Carrier for the permission set's review, #37269.** Two live links write a permission set's `?review=1` today: the Packages page's per-draft review link (`PackagesPage.tsx:1317`) and the chat's 「Review N changes」 (`AppContent.tsx:286`). Both open the matrix page with no review, as on main. #37269 makes the matrix page show the draft's changes; this PR does not change what those links open.
  - The census rows for `AccessPillar.tsx` and `AutomationsPillar.tsx` `setRailOpen` both go: both rails are gone.
- **Merged `origin/main` again at `6211ddf4`**, after #37185 (the authenticated fetch) and #37232 (the menu's type table) landed and the PR showed a conflict. Two files conflicted, each resolved so both sides survive: `CommandPalette.studioScope-11863.test.tsx` (one comment above the shared `@object-ui/plugin-detail` warm-up; main's wording kept) and `FlowItemMoreMenu.tsx` (main's `authFetch` for the clone door kept; the `STUDIO_HEADER_ICON_BUTTON` import this branch had dropped as unused stays dropped). #37168 had still not merged, so the exemption below stands.
- **Merged `origin/main` a third time, at `1b91538b` (#37168, the object designer).** This PR now lands second of the pair, so it carries the routing ruling. The 47 conflict hunks in 22 files were resolved so both designers survive:
  - `AREA_DESIGNER_PAGE_TYPES = ['permission', 'object', 'flow']`, and `STUDIO_ITEM_PILLAR` is empty.
  - `AreaItemOpen` mounts `DataPillar` for an object, `AutomationsPillar` for a flow and `StudioPermissionSetPage` for a set. #37168's `type === 'object'` review gate is replaced by the one `EditPage` rule; it gives the object the same answer.
  - Both creates' `onOpenExisting` paths are kept: the object's at its target package, the flow's in this package. The prop, which both PRs added, is passed once.
  - Both old-pillar redirects (`/data`, `/automations`) are kept.

Each is deleted. What they pinned for items is pinned per item: the area keys each designer by item, and `heldFlowLeave-26705`'s › case pins that the next flow opens clean, with nothing sent.
- **`AreaHistoryRedirect`'s designer-item exemption (`pillarItem`) is deleted** (seat 4's routing: the second lander of #37168 and #37169 deletes it). With `STUDIO_ITEM_PILLAR` empty it could no longer fire. `routes-28561`'s CONTROL keeps its own-`EditPage` leg (the standalone history page), and its object leg is repointed at the object designer's History tab; the flow's `/history` opens the flow designer's History tab (the case beside it).
- The closing line on line 1 is kept this round (N4): the maintainer is still to answer card item 2.
- N2: the stale `/studio/~org/automations` comments in `src/index.ts` and `studioScope.ts` now name the scope's area addresses.
- N3: not changed. The caption's `title="API name: …"` predates this PR: main's pillar header set the same `titleProps.title`, and 20 test lookups across 15 suites key on it. A cut label's hover still shows the API name; the changeset now names the api-name chip instead of a tooltip.

The `~org` leg's context is pinned on the pure `orgScopeFlowOf` in `metadataArea.test.ts`.
